responsibility: Specializes the SH target for the vendor="superh" embedded simulator/board environment. It overrides linker emulation, board/runtime spec fragments, CPP and assembler runtime additions, startfile and library selection, and related spec hooks so SH4 little-endian embedded builds can pick up SuperH board defaults while still allowing external specs files to replace them.
same_name_distinction: This is the SuperH vendor subtarget header that overrides specs, linker emulation, startup, library, CPP, and assembler defaults for the superh environment, whereas superh.opt only declares the extra vendor-specific command-line options accepted by that configuration.
